mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_benefit_log ( account_id, prev_status, new_status, changed_at, reason ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{prevStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{changedAt}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT benefit_id, account_id, prev_status, new_status, changed_at, reason FROM account_benefit_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY changed_at ASC, benefit_id ASC
SELECT benefit_id, account_id, prev_status, new_status, changed_at, reason FROM account_benefit_log WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY changed_at DESC, benefit_id DESC LIMIT 1
